information.description:
Your basic guard that’s seen combat, gotten better training, or just has a hefty gear budget thanks to their employer. No matter the reason, these guards are more likely to put down unruly punks that underestimate the perks of corporate contracts.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Generics).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
